end.summary:
Reyansh practised top, front and side views of solids.
They correctly identified views of glasses, dice, caps, spheres, cones, cylinders, cubes and cooker lids.
They matched objects to views accurately in the recorded tasks.
They explained that an object can look different from different places, with one incorrect explanation.
The handle-visibility mix-up was not corrected later in the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised describing objects by focusing on what can be seen from the top, front or side. Reyansh used this method correctly for several objects, including a steel glass, cube, sphere, cone and cylinder. They mixed up whether a cup handle would be visible from both sides, and this was not corrected later. At home, ask Reyansh to draw a cup from the front and back, showing the handle only when it would be visible.
